title: Attention Mechanism — Build the Whole Score Table at Once
key_insight: The score tensor includes batch, head, query-position, and key-position dimensions. A mask must broadcast to those dimensions without hiding valid positions.
body:
## Build the Whole Score Table at Once

Calculating every pair in loops is slow. Matrix multiplication forms all query-key scores for a batch and head together.

The score tensor includes batch, head, query-position, and key-position dimensions. A mask must broadcast to those dimensions without hiding valid positions.

Attention weights consume memory proportional to pairs of positions. Long contexts therefore pressure memory even when model parameter count stays fixed.
common_mistakes: Attention always selects exactly one word.
Queries, keys, and values are raw English questions and answers.
A causal mask reveals future tokens during generation.

real_world_usage: Attention is the core routing idea that lets transformers connect distant information.
